gate: best trace-outcome AUROC >= 0.65 (dense process-reward carries outcome signal)
interpretation: Reference: a perfect OUTCOME verifier -> AUROC 1.0; chance -> 0.5. The moat's PER-STEP (in-format) AUROC was 0.967. This trace-OUTCOME AUROC of aggregated process-reward on FREE-FORM generations is the gate for the process-reward path. If it is ~0.5-0.6 the per-step signal does not transfer to outcome ranking -> process-reward training would reward-hack.
title: process_reward_predicts_outcome
